Priest.note: From the BlizzCon demo. Fear Ward is now baseline for every Priest. Night Elf and Troll spells read from level 38 spellbook tooltips.
Priest.source: Warcraft Tavern, 12 Sep 2026; Dark Sacrifice tooltip from demo footage; Night Elf spells read from Savix's Twitch VOD of 12 Sep 2026 (5h02m); Troll spells from demo spellbook screenshots shared by Schiffers on Reddit, 13 Sep 2026 (rank 3 tooltips at level 38), matched by admiralbfalcon's captures from Xaryu's stream; Gnome Contingency Plan tooltip from admiralbfalcon, 13 Sep 2026.

Undead.name: Dark Sacrifice
Undead.description: Instant, 10 min cooldown. Cannibalize 720 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 720 Mana. (Rank 2, level 38 values.)

Troll.name: Hex of Weakness
Troll.description: Changed. Rank 3: 45 mana, instant, 30 yd. Reduces the target's melee attack power by 85 and the effectiveness of healing on it by 20% for 2 min. (Classic reduced flat melee damage instead of attack power.)

Troll.name: Shadowguard
Troll.description: Rank 3: 30 mana, instant. Shadows strike anyone who hits you with a spell, melee or ranged attack for 76 Shadow damage, once every few seconds, no threat. 3 charges, lasts 10 min.

Dwarf.name: Chastise
Dwarf.description: Holy damage plus a short root, as in TBC.

Dwarf.name: Desperate Prayer
Dwarf.description: Instantly heals you, as in TBC.

Gnome.name: Contingency Plan
Gnome.description: Rank 2 at 38: 220 mana, instant, 30 yd, 10 min cooldown. Places a Holy ward on an ally for 15 sec; the next hit that drops them below 35% health gives them a 290 absorb and heals 338 over 15 sec. One Contingency Plan per target. Read from a demo spellbook tooltip.

Human.name: Divine Grace
Human.description: Cooldown that removes Weakened Soul from the target and heals them.

Night Elf.name: Elune's Grace
Night Elf.description: Changed. Instant, 26 mana, 5 min cooldown: reduces the chance you will be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times. (Classic: ranged only, plus dodge, 3 min cooldown.) Read from the demo spellbook at level 38.

Night Elf.name: Starshards
Night Elf.description: Changed. Rank 4 at 38: 190 mana, 30 yd, channeled, 30 sec cooldown. Rains starshards on the target for 816 Arcane damage over 6 sec. (Classic: no cooldown and far less damage.) Read from a demo spellbook tooltip.
